titulo: The remote that made the TV a third more expensive

frases.texto: Your TV remote once made the TV a third more expensive.
The remote was just a hammer hitting a metal rod.
The costly part was six glass tubes inside the TV.
That sound is too high for you to hear, so the tubes were the ear.
Those six tubes added about a third to the price.
Later those tubes shrank down to a tiny chip.
And that sound became a light you can't see.
Now your phone is the remote.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who keeps buying batteries.
